subject: sentences
title: Commas in a list
about: A comma goes between the things in a list of three or more (cats, dogs, and fish), with one before the and; he also counts how many things a list names. Common Core puts commas in a series in first grade (its L.1.2.c), while North Carolina's conventions continuum (L.1.2) lists them in grade 2, so this is a stretch level that follows Commas in dates.
tip: Have him count the things in the list on his fingers, then check there is a comma after each one except the last.

cards.q: Which sentence has the commas in the right places?
cards.a: I like cats, dogs, and fish.
wrong: I like cats dogs and fish.
I like, cats dogs and, fish.
cards.note: In a list of three, a comma goes after each thing except the last: cats, dogs, and fish.

cards.q: Which sentence has the commas in the right places?
cards.note: Three names in a list get commas too: Sam, Mia, and Ben.

cards.q: Which sentence has the commas in the right places?
cards.a: We ate ham, eggs, and jam.
wrong: We ate ham eggs and jam.
We, ate ham eggs, and jam.
cards.note: The commas go between the foods, not after we.

cards.q: Which sentence has the commas in the right places?
cards.a: Dad got nuts, buns, and corn.
wrong: Dad got nuts buns and corn.
Dad, got nuts buns, and corn.
cards.note: The commas go between the things Dad got, not after Dad.

cards.q: Pick the sentence with the commas in the right spots.
cards.a: Zoe has cats, dogs, and hens.
wrong: Zoe has cats dogs and hens.
Zoe, has cats dogs, and hens.
cards.note: A comma after cats and a comma after dogs keep the three pets apart.

cards.q: Pick the sentence with the commas in the right spots.
cards.a: I see red, blue, and green.
wrong: I see red blue and green.
I see, red blue, and green.
cards.note: Three colors in a list: red, blue, and green.

cards.q: Pick the sentence with the commas in the right spots.
cards.a: Max can hop, skip, and jump.
wrong: Max can hop skip and jump.
Max, can hop skip, and jump.
cards.note: Action words can make a list too: hop, skip, and jump.

cards.q: Pick the list that is written the right way.
cards.note: A comma after apples, a comma after pears, then and plums.

cards.q: Pick the list that is written the right way.
cards.note: The comma comes before and, never after it.

cards.q: Pick the list that is written the right way.
cards.note: Names in a list get commas too, with the last comma before and.

cards.q: Pick the list that is written the right way.
cards.note: A shopping list: milk, eggs, and bread.

cards.q: I like cats, dogs, and fish. How many things are in the list?
cards.note: Count the things the commas keep apart: cats, dogs, fish. That is three.

cards.q: Mia has hats, cups, socks, and pens. How many things are in the list?
cards.note: Hats, cups, socks, pens. Four things, so three commas.

cards.q: We saw a cow, a pig, and a hen. How many animals are in the list?
cards.note: A cow, a pig, a hen. That is three animals.

cards.q: Ben ate ham and eggs. How many things did Ben eat?
cards.note: Just two things only need the word and. The commas start when there are three or more.

cards.q: Red, blue, green, and pink. How many colors are in the list?
cards.note: Red, blue, green, pink. Four colors, so three commas.
